# xshield_templates (Data Source)

Templates matching a criteria, with how widely each is assigned.

Only two template types exist, `application-template` and `block-template`. Rule counts are reported here; read a single template through `xshield_template` for its ports and paths.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "xshield_templates" "block" {
  criteria = "templateType = 'block-template'"
}

output "unassigned" {
  value = [
    for t in data.xshield_templates.block.templates : t.template_name
    if t.segment_assignments == 0
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `criteria` (String) Criteria selecting the templates. Defaults to every template.
- `max_results` (Number) Stop after this many results. Left unset, every match is read. When a limit truncates the result set, `truncated` is true.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) Ids of the matching templates, in the same order as the detailed list. Convenient for `for_each`.
- `templates` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))
- `total` (Number) Total number of templates matching the criteria, as reported by the API.
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when `max_results` stopped the read before the end of the result set.

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `access_policy_template` (Boolean)
- `asset_assignments` (Number) Assets the template is applied to.
- `assigned_by_tag_based_policy` (Boolean)
- `colortokens_managed` (Boolean) True for a template shipped with the platform, which cannot be edited.
- `id` (String)
- `path_count` (Number) Number of path rules in the template.
- `port_count` (Number) Number of port rules in the template.
- `segment_assignments` (Number) Segments the template is attached to.
- `template_category` (String)
- `template_description` (String)
- `template_name` (String)
- `template_type` (String) Either application-template or block-template.
